output.brief:
The Kestria buffering is not caused by the new CDN. It comes from the smart-TV app 5.2 release. Kestria was the canary market and went to 100% on 9 Oct. The release lowered the player's startup buffer from 10 s to 4 s. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall 5.9% of the time. Every other client on the same ISPs and the same Tessaline CDN stalls about 0.6%. Smart-TV 5.1 devices that haven't updated are also fine. Dogfood testing on the old CDN, Corvane, showed the same problem (5.7% vs 0.6%), and that finding was deferred. The handball launch and ISP congestion don't fit the data. Match nights showed no change, and the other clients on those ISPs are fine.
Recommendation: don't send the SLA breach notice, withhold fees or move traffic back. That would not fix the problem and would harm the vendor relationship. Don't mute the alert. Revert Kestria to the 5.1 buffer settings through the remote-config profile, which takes about an hour. Hold the 20 Nov wider rollout until it's fixed. Add app-version and device breakdowns to the dashboard. Whether buffering drove October cancellations is unproven, because the 1 October price rise is a confounder. Hold off on the free-month offer until the exit-survey data is checked. I'm fairly confident in this diagnosis.
